source_ready_lane.input: the full immutable family-specific coarse evidence order from PR 231
source_ready_lane.algorithm: scan the full coarse order from first to last; accept a candidate as a fine-expansion seed iff its 5-km geodesic footprint covers at least one source-ready candidate not already covered by previously accepted seeds; continue until the entire source-ready lane is covered or the order is exhausted
source_ready_lane.coarse_order_role: priority only; it does not determine an arbitrary stopping count

source_indeterminate_lane.algorithm: stable geometry-only greedy 5-km set cover over the retained-indeterminate candidates; at each step choose the candidate covering the most currently uncovered indeterminate candidates, break ties by stable candidate SHA-256; continue until every retained-indeterminate candidate is covered

distance_semantics.cross_candidate_area_barrier: none at seed stage; this is only a deterministic fine-expansion seed compression over the already frozen Japan outer-frame points

fine_expansion_boundary.seed_center_role: center of a later 5-km fine ecological expansion frame only

forbidden: do not stop after an arbitrary Top-k
do not use a score threshold to decide seed count
do not use survey days, monetary budget, user site count or field outcomes
do not rank source-indeterminate candidates below source-ready candidates because their public source is missing
do not let a source-ready seed cover or eliminate the source-indeterminate lane
do not interpret 5-km seed coverage as species presence, habitat suitability or field recovery
next_gate: Execute and hash the four source-ready seed orders and four retained-indeterminate geometry-only seed sets; then freeze exact 5-km fine-frame construction around those seeds before materializing 100-m structural grids.
